title: 第9章 绝代A级御兽墨玉狐第10章 深渊暴龙深渊崽子们的妈
slug: 御兽别人鉴定都是骗你开神兽
content_zh:
;;
刚才乔简对马科的虾仁猪心，陈小草并没有说话。
直到他走出去一截，两人几乎是异口同声的开了口。
“大哥，该履行合约了。”
“主播，能不能再帮我选一个蛋？”
陈小草一愣。
这人不是刚好5星兽师吗？难道这个a级御兽还不能满足他的需求，他还想再换一只御兽？
乔简还真是想换御兽。
他想再贪一手。
今天的成功，让乔简又想起三天前，被骑士团拿走的那枚御兽蛋。
那可是b级开出s级御兽的极品蛋。
尽管理智一直在告诉他，这种事件发生的概率微乎其微。
可万一呢？
乔简想了想，反手又在直播间中刷了好几万的礼物，解释道。
“除了给你买一枚b级御兽蛋的钱之外，我还可以再购买一颗御兽蛋。”
“这样吧，在你挑选御兽蛋的同时，你再帮我挑选一颗，当然，这一次以你的需求为先，如何？”
如何？
陈小草眉峰一挑。
当然不如何了！
“第一，我说了，我每天只有一次机会可以挑选优秀的御兽蛋。”

“第二，我说了，我这个能力，很贵！”
想白嫖？合约签了，你身为饵料的作用也发挥了。
鼻涕到嘴了你知道甩了，脑袋撞墙你知道拐了。
早干嘛去了？
乔简被态度突变的陈小草噎了一瞬，但很快他就想明白了里面的道道。
只能无奈的摇了摇头。
看来，精的可不止他一个人啊！
他也不敢因为陈小草拒绝就拿对方怎么样。
先不说具有帝国律法效应的合约。
单单对方这一手神乎其技的玄学开蛋术，就不是他敢得罪的。
要知道，他现在只是5星兽师而已。
这个世界上，人人都可以契约御兽。
第一只御兽契约成功后，每个人都会成为0星兽师。
届时，就可以带着自己的御兽，与别人组队或是自己独自进入遍布各个兽神大陆的副本。

Just now, Chen Xiaocao didn't say anything to Qiao Jian about Ma Ke's shrimp and pig heart.
It wasn't until he walked out that the two of them spoke almost in unison.
"Brother, it's time to fulfill the contract."
"Anchor, can you help me choose another egg?"
Chen Xiaocao was stunned.
Isn't this person just a 5-star beast master? Could it be that this A-level beast master can't meet his needs, and he wants to change to another beast master?
Qiao Jian really wanted to change the beast control.
He wanted to get greedy again.
Today's success reminded Qiao Jian of the beast-controlling egg that was taken away by the knights three days ago.
That's a top-notch B-level egg that produces an S-level beast.
Although his reason kept telling him that the probability of such an event happening was extremely slim.
But what if?
Qiao Jian thought for a while, then bought tens of thousands more gifts in the live broadcast room and explained.
"In addition to giving you the money to buy a B-level beast-taming egg, I can also buy another beast-taming egg."
"Let's do this. While you are choosing the beast-control egg, you can help me choose another one. Of course, this time, your needs will come first. How about it?"
How?
Chen Xiaocao raised his eyebrows.
Of course not!
"First, as I said, I only have one chance to choose an excellent beast-controlling egg every day."
"Second, as I said, my ability is very expensive!"
Want to have sex for nothing? The contract is signed, and your role as bait is also fulfilled.
When the snot reaches your mouth, you know it's gone; when your head hits the wall, you know it's turned around.
What did you do early?
Qiao Jian was choked for a moment by Chen Xiaocao's sudden change of attitude, but soon he understood the meaning behind it.
He could only shake his head helplessly.
It seems that he is not the only one who is smart!
He didn't dare to do anything to Chen Xiaocao just because he refused.
Let’s not talk about contracts that have the effect of imperial law.
He wouldn't dare offend the other party's miraculous metaphysical egg-opening technique alone.
You know, he is only a 5-star beast master now.
In this world, everyone can contract to control beasts.
After the first beast control contract is successful, everyone will become a 0-star beast master.
At that time, you can bring your own beast master, team up with others, or enter the dungeons all over the Beast God Continent alone.
